title: Role-Labelled Document Outline
description: A content-blind document description, global themes, and a flat ordered outline whose items each receive one primary functional role.

format.description: The exact document format whose role vocabulary was used.

document_description.description: A content-blind, source-independent description of the document type, venue, audience, and register.

global_themes.description: The document's distinct highest-level substantive contributions.

items.description: A flat list of role-labelled outline items in document order.

id.description: The item's position in the outline. IDs must be consecutive integers beginning with 1.

content.description: A concise, source-independent statement of one substantive, rhetorical, or structural commitment.

verbatim.description: True only when the item intentionally preserves source wording whose exact form is substantive.

role_name.description: The exact name of one supplied format-specific role or the reserved role Other.
